name: MCP1 by Appwrite
description: Put a team's MCP servers behind one gateway URL with OAuth sign-in, per-tool rules by role and group, and an audit log of every tool call, for teams rolling out MCP clients.

skills.name: Create Gateway
skills.description: Bundles installed MCP servers behind one gateway URL and grants it to groups with full or read-only access.

skills.name: Set Tool Rules
skills.description: Limits servers and single tools to groups, sets a minimum role per tool, blocks or confirms destructive tools and rate-limits calls.

skills.name: Search Tools
skills.description: Searches tools across a gateway's servers and runs them with mcp1__search_tools and mcp1__call_tool, keeping tool definitions small.

skills.name: Audit Tool Calls
skills.description: Records every tool call with who made it, through which client and gateway, how long it took and whether it was allowed.

skills.name: Connect Servers
skills.description: Connects catalog MCP servers in one click with OAuth, or any remote server by URL, keeping their tokens encrypted and refreshed.
